races.name: Coral 'Daily Rewards Shaker' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A typically interesting novice for the track with AQUA BLEU selected to come out on top. Warren Greatrex's 4-y-o boasts plenty of experience having scored 3 times in junior hurdles last season and with his Aintree reappearance second under his belt, he's interesting now tackling a longer trip. Well Achieved landed his only start in points and is respected, with recent course runner up Sappingirl and returning Trial by Jury others commanding plenty of respect.

  1. AQUA BLEU (IRE)
  2. WELL ACHIEVED (IRE)
  3. SAPPINGIRL (IRE)

races.name: Play Coral 'Racing-Super-Series' Mares' Novices' Hurdle (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FAIRY PARK seems a bit of an edgy sort but she looked a good prospect on the evidence of her 2 bumper efforts last season, which she duly confirmed when hammering a next-time-out winner on her Ffos Las hurdling debut, and strikes as the type to go on to much better things. Expensive point recruit Royal Response impressed over C&D earlier in the month and is open to plenty of improvement, too, while the scopey Ti'mamzel shouldn't be taken lightly as a dual listed bumper winner.

  1. FAIRY PARK (IRE)
  2. ROYAL RESPONSE (IRE)
  3. TI'MAMZEL (FR)

races.name: Coral Sir Peter O'Sullevan Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks ultra competitive with the progressive NORN IRON topping the shortlist having prevented a Willie Mullins 1-2-3 when second at the Punchestown Festival. This test could be ideal for Jipcot, while Venetia Williams saddles a couple of interesting runners in Demnat and Holetown.

  1. NORN IRON (IRE)
  2. JIPCOT (FR)
  3. DEMNAT (FR)

races.name: Coral 'Bet10 Get50 Sign Up Offer' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GENTLEMAN TOBOOT looks well treated on his strong novice hurdle form and appeals most at the prices. Dan Skelton's Moneygarrow will rightly be popular in the market, and he's feared most ahead of strong-travelling Spirits Bay. Court In The Act and A King Of Magic complete the shortlist for this competitive renewal.

  1. GENTLEMAN TOBOOT (IRE)
  2. MONEYGARROW (IRE)
  3. SPIRITS BAY

races.name: Coral Racing Club Intermediate Handicap Hurdle (Reg' As The Gerry Feilden) (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A good-looking renewal of the Gerry Feilden. IDAHO SUN was seen to better effect than subsequent Supreme third Mydaddypaddy when accounting for him in the Grade 1 Formby at Aintree when last seen, but that form still makes him look well treated from an opening mark in the early 140s, so there's every reason to believe he can maintain his unbeaten record over hurdles. Mondo Man is well worth another chance given the strength of his Imperial Cup win, with The Mighty Celt completing the shortlist.

  1. IDAHO SUN (IRE)
  2. MONDO MAN
  3. THE MIGHTY CELT (IRE)

races.name: Coral Gold Cup Handicap Chase (Registered As The Newbury Gold Cup) (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WENDIGO got away without his handicap mark going up for his Carlisle reappearance success, a move which could prove lenient based on what was a clear career best on Timeform ratings. This 7-y-o should prove capable of even better now stepping back up in trip and can provide his stable with a second recent win in this. Regent's Stroll, whose novice form ties in with recent Paddy Power victor Meetmebythesea, Road To Home and Miami Magic are feared most in that order.

  1. WENDIGO (FR)
  2. REGENT'S STROLL (IRE)
  3. ROAD TO HOME (IRE)

races.name: Coral 'Pipped-At-The-Post' And Win Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WRECKLESS ERIC made a promising start in this sphere when runner-up at Ffos Las and can build on it to go one better off a handy-looking mark here. Last year's victor Ryan's Rocket is also of interest off his current mark and rates a big threat though, while both Un Sens A La Vie and Largy Belter command plenty of respect with better days still ahead. Pure Carbon and The Four Sixes complete the shortlist in this cracking handicap.

  1. WRECKLESS ERIC
  2. RYAN'S ROCKET (IRE)
  3. UN SENS A LA VIE (FR)

races.name: Dane Architectural Systems Millionaire EBF 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NIKOLAVS OTTO caught the eye in a Perth maiden that has worked out very well and could be the value play up against Willie Mullins' Leader Allen, who's likely to be a warm order.

  1. NIKOLAVS OTTO (IRE)
  2. LEADER ALLEN (FR)
  3. MEASURE OF A MAN (IRE)

races.name: J&D Pierce Steeling The Race Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
RED DELTA shaped well when fourth behind Passengerontheship at Sedgefield (boosted form since) on his return and showed his liking for this track when an excellent third in last season's Eider Chase so gets the vote on these revised terms. The latter named rates a big threat though in his hat-trick bid, while Impatient and I Wish You can also play a prominent role in this intriguing handicap.

  1. RED DELTA
  2. PASSENGERONTHESHIP (IRE)
  3. IMPATIENT (FR)

races.name: Weatherbys And Birdie Calendars 'The French Furze' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A tough call to split OLD COAST ROAD and Splendid Fellow on these terms. Dan Skelton's unbeaten hurdler perhaps has the greater potential and is narrowly preferred to the Irish standard-setter.

  1. OLD COAST ROAD (IRE)
  2. SPLENDID FELLOW (IRE)
  3. LAUVERGNAT (FR)

races.name: SES Engineering Powering Past The Rehearsal Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Anthony Honeyball holds a solid hand here with JORDANS CROSS and Crest of Fortune, the former taken to get back on track with the form of his Cheltenham win at the start of the year proving strong. Venetia Williams has a good record in this, so Alcedo is another to consider having won at this meeting 12 months ago.

  1. JORDANS CROSS (IRE)
  2. CREST OF FORTUNE
  3. ALCEDO (IRE)

races.name: Bowmer And Kirkland We Build As One Fighting Fifth Hurdle (Grade 1) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A good opportunity for ALEXEI to land a breakthrough Grade 1 success. Last year's winner of this race Golden Ace was held by Joe Tizzard's charge during the spring, and it could be improving Mydaddypaddy that gives the selection most to think about.

  1. ALEXEI (GER)
  2. MYDADDYPADDY (IRE)
  3. GOLDEN ACE

races.name: Ryder & Cundall Designed To Go The Distance Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CAVE BRIDGE made an encouraging handicap debut after 12 months off when sixth in a big field at Newbury and could be the answer with this longer trip expected to suit. The Kalooki Kid was rather unlucky to bump into one back in this sphere at Wetherby so rates the main threat ahead of the progressive Las Canals.

  1. CAVE BRIDGE (IRE)
  2. THE KALOOKI KID
  3. LAS CANALS (FR)

races.name: Jodie Standing's Point-To-Point Recruits Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Progressive ALBIE LITTLEWOOD is fancied to bring up the 4-timer for the Skeltons. Looking Splendid and Diamond Mix both appeal as solid dangers, while class-dropper Genois needs a close look in the betting.

  1. ALBIE LITTLEWOOD (IRE)
  2. LOOKING SPLENDID
  3. DIAMOND MIX (IRE)

races.name: Josie Rowe Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
EVERYONESGAME had the form of his reappearance second at Plumpton well and truly boosted when the winner that day finished runner up in a big field handicap at Cheltenham recently and, entitled to come forward from that (won second start after a break last winter) he could well be ready to repeat the feat. Paddy de Pole comes here firmly at the top of his game and may emerge next best, though Docpickedme's fine record on Town Moor means he can't be discounted either.

  1. EVERYONESGAME (IRE)
  2. PADDY DE POLE (IRE)
  3. DOCPICKEDME (IRE)

races.name: Howcroft Group Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DOWN TO BUSINESS has to concede weight all round back in novice company but he lines up having looked an unlucky loser in a Wetherby handicap 2 weeks ago and may well be up to the task given that was his best effort yet. Dancing Soldier is an interesting hurdles newcomer, whilst One Knight remains with definite potential in this sphere judged on his useful bumper form.

  1. DOWN TO BUSINESS
  2. DANCING SOLDIER (IRE)
  3. ONE KNIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Winter Family Raceday 29th December Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A small field but it looks competitive with 3 progressive last-time-out winners, NAZARE shading the vote over Fairlawn Skipper and Palamon.

  1. NAZARE (FR)
  2. FAIRLAWN SKIPPER
  3. PALAMON (IRE)

races.name: Dranfields CIU National Charity Raceday Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This could be an interesting tussle between QUEEN ALICE and Briery Rose. The former showed plenty in a notable Fairyhouse bumper and may make a successful hurdling/stable debut in receipt of 6 lbs.

  1. QUEEN ALICE
  2. BRIERY ROSE
  3. LADY LITIGATOR (IRE)

races.name: Apres Village Friday 18th December Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
There's more to come from LIBERTY COACH over hurdles and he's fancied to double up. Rewired is feared as the main danger, especially if supported, with Dan Skelton's Leaumec de Mee potentially anchored by an 11 lb rise.

  1. LIBERTY COACH
  2. REWIRED
  3. LEAUMEC DE MEE (FR)

races.name: Doncaster 2027 Annual Membership Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
COPSHILL LAD underperformed at Ffos Las when last seen in May but he has a notably good record fresh, which makes him an appealing proposition. Camarrate has run well on all 3 of his chase starts and seems likely to give another good account, while Mumford's Magic is also respected back down in grade.

  1. COPSHILL LAD (IRE)
  2. CAMARRATE (IRE)
  3. MUMFORD'S MAGIC (IRE)

races.name: Grace And Dotty Fillies' 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
IGNITE THE NIGHT shaped encouragingly from the back of the field in a slowly-run race when a place behind Lady Loki on her debut at Stratford last month, so there's plenty of reason to believe she can reverse the form with that rival and come out on top. Sarah's Surprise makes most appeal of the newcomers before market clues.

  1. IGNITE THE NIGHT
  2. LADY LOKI
  3. SARAH'S SURPRISE

races.name: Hope House Children's Hospices Conditional Jockeys' Training Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Quite a difficult race to assess with MALINAS GLORY just about the most persuasive option on the back of a more encouraging effort back hurdling at Hereford with a good-value conditional also booked. Cahier's Den should run closer to form this time, with Eaststone Buck's another to consider on his reappearance.

  1. MALINAS GLORY (IRE)
  2. CAHIER'S DEN (IRE)
  3. EASTSTONE BUCK'S

races.name: Wrexham Lager Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Bumper winners POINTOFDIFFERENCE and Cool Customer ought to come to the fore here. The latter has the benefit of experience over obstacles but the former looked useful last month so is marginally preferred. Point recruit Koaly Play also needs considering.

  1. POINTOFDIFFERENCE
  2. COOL CUSTOMER (IRE)
  3. KOALY PLAY (IRE)

races.name: Howard Evans Roofing & Cladding Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks an interesting race but Henry Daly has his string in good order and TRINITY STREET has all the hallmarks of one who will take to fences. She therefore receives the vote in favour of Twistthenightaway and Pottersville.

  1. TRINITY STREET (IRE)
  2. TWISTTHENIGHTAWAY (IRE)
  3. POTTERSVILLE (IRE)

races.name: Paul Ferguson Jumpers To Follow Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
SCOTT'S LEGACY wasn't up to Grade 2 company at Cheltenham but could be a cut above back in a lower grade. Donald McCain point winner Works For Me is one who might give him something to think about, while Trojan Tale is surely better than he showed on his first attempt over hurdles.

  1. SCOTT'S LEGACY (IRE)
  2. WORKS FOR ME (IRE)
  3. TROJAN TALE (IRE)

races.name: Paul Ferguson Jumpers To Follow Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
HANG OUT is the percentage call on the back of his recent C&D hurdle debut success. Loki achieved enough on the Flat to think he should be able to make his presence felt at this level over hurdles, while Written in Gold is a newcomer who would enter calculations if the betting speaks in his favour.

  1. HANG OUT (IRE)
  2. LOKI (GER)
  3. WRITTEN IN GOLD (IRE)

races.name: Follow Dave Win 60th Birthday Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DOCTORS HILL made a pleasing start to his chase career at Ffos Las and is given a chance to build on that promise, particularly as hat-trick seeker Royal Mer has peak fitness to prove after a break. Ben Pauling chase newcomer The Hawkstonian and Venetia Williams French recruit Luron d'Oudairies are other interesting runners.

  1. DOCTORS HILL
  2. ROYAL MER (FR)
  3. THE HAWKSTONIAN (IRE)

races.name: Pennine Flooring On The Radio Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GASMANI shaped promisingly on his chasing debut when runner-up over this C&D a month ago, form which has been working out well, and he can build on that effort to go one better. Big Cadillac isn't taken lightly, though, having made a successful start to his chasing career, with The Price of Peace one to note for last year's winning yard.

  1. GASMANI (IRE)
  2. BIG CADILLAC (IRE)
  3. THE PRICE OF PEACE (IRE)

races.name: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An excellent opportunity for LEVENS HALL to defy a penalty. Aura Champagne looks more solid than El Nay and she shades the vote for next best. Newcomer Francesca's Dream is also worth considering for the places if backed.

  1. LEVENS HALL
  2. AURA CHAMPAGNE (IRE)
  3. EL NAY (IRE)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
races.verdict:
ARTHUR CARROT had a bit more in hand than the final margin indicates when accounting for stablemate Bacha at Lingfield the previous week, so a 6 lb higher mark looks well within his compass, especially as it's doubtful we've seen the best of him yet. Odegaard has shaped well on both his nursery outings and is one to take seriously, while last-time-out winner Thai Baht should have the race run to suit again on her first try at 7f.

  1. ARTHUR CARROT
  2. ODEGAARD
  3. THAI BAHT

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
GOLDWORK found some improvement with all equipment removed in what appeared a good race for the level on his first tapeta start here recently and is fancied to follow up from an 8 lb higher mark. Lady Mariko and Tasdeed head the opposition.

  1. GOLDWORK
  2. LADY MARIKO
  3. TASDEED (FR)

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
NATIVE HONEY has struggled for consistency but he's unexposed on all-weather and a 3 lb higher mark for his win over C&D 6 weeks earlier looks well within his compass. Stenmark and Decem Starr are a couple of others to consider.

  1. NATIVE HONEY (IRE)
  2. STENMARK (IRE)
  3. DECEM STARR (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
There was definite promise to glean from UNFURLED's debut second at Wolverhampton 32 days ago and, appealing as a likely improver with that run under her belt, she could be the answer with her yard firmly amongst the winners of late. Mantuba and Secha are 2 very appealing newcomers from leading stables and may offer up chief resistance before market clues.

  1. UNFURLED (IRE)
  2. MANTUBA (IRE)
  3. SECHA

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
races.verdict:
PALMS OASIS continued his theme of race-by-race progress when opening his account at the third attempt in a C&D novice 3 weeks ago, defeating a next-time-out winner in the process. An opening mark of 74 looks fair on that evidence and he's selected to follow up. Blue Pete is another going the right way and feared, with similar comments applying to Henley on Thames. Lady Blanche also worthy of note in a good race of its type.

  1. PALMS OASIS
  2. BLUE PETE (IRE)
  3. HENLEY ON THAMES (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict:
Dual C&D winner ELYAM maintained his 100% record for Michael Herrington and found further progress to boot when bringing up the hat-trick in determined style at Newcastle 4 weeks ago. A low-mileage 4-y-o, he firmly appeals as the type to rate higher still and is selected to defy the handicapper again. Ancient State has been a fine advert for the Adam Kirby yard this year and is feared, whilst a pace duel could well bring admirable veteran Baldomero into contention late in the piece.

  1. ELYAM
  2. ANCIENT STATE (IRE)
  3. BALDOMERO (IRE)

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2027 Not 2007 Handicap
races.verdict:
LEADING TIMES is easily one of the least exposed and found further progress when making a winning stable debut over C&D 3 weeks ago, finding plenty for pressure to edge out Toolatetonegotiate late on. Further progress rates a distinct possibility and he looks a big player again nudged up 2 lb. Sir Yoshi wasn't disgraced last time and faces his easiest assignment for some time, so commands respect despite a poor strike rate. Aforementioned Toolatetonegotiate completes the shortlist.

  1. LEADING TIMES
  2. SIR YOSHI (IRE)
  3. TOOLATETONEGOTIATE

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Borderline smart at his best, CASTLE COVE looks the one to be with on second start back from an absence. Andrew Balding's improving Lord d'Or is feared most ahead of Tawajjah, who has made an excellent start for current connections.

  1. CASTLE COVE (IRE)
  2. LORD D'OR (GER)
  3. TAWAJJAH (IRE)

races.name: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
KING RASKO GREY sets the standard on hurdles form and is taken to make a winning chase debut in a quality maiden, with the strength in depth at the yard making it no surprise that his chief dangers also come from Closutton, Kiely’s Place and Narciso Has both appealing as exciting recruits in their own right.

  1. KING RASKO GREY (FR)
  2. KIELY'S PLACE (IRE)
  3. NARCISO HAS (FR)

races.name: Activ8 Solar Energies Irish EBF Mares Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
KARAMOJA caught the eye off this mark in the spring and, given time to get over her fall at Punchestown in May, is taken to double her tally in this sphere. Karia Des Blaises is likely to prove the main danger if avoiding mistakes, with The Great Nudie respected after shaping much better than the result on return. Break My Soul arrives on the back of a poor effort but is one to note if strong in the market.

  1. KARAMOJA (FR)
  2. KARIA DES BLAISES (FR)
  3. THE GREAT NUDIE (IRE)

races.name: EASYFIX Equine Handicap Chase (Listed)
races.verdict:
WINGMEN showed good resolution to rally and lead close home at Navan a fortnight ago and is fancied to follow up back in handicap company. Western Diego is feared most returned to this venue having been placed in this race last year before landing a valuable C&D handicap, while Raffles Dolce Vita and Moudan are also respected.

  1. WINGMEN (IRE)
  2. WESTERN DIEGO (IRE)
  3. RAFFLES DOLCE VITA (FR)

races.name: Mullinam Hurdle (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
SARATOGA ended last season firmly on the up with a Grade 1 success at Punchestown and gets a confident vote to make a winning return and successfully concede weight all round. Huntin Boots impressed when scoring at Gowran recently and appeals as the one to chase home Padraig Roche's hat-trick seeker ahead of Bartholomew.

  1. SARATOGA (IRE)
  2. HUNTIN BOOTS (IRE)
  3. BARTHOLOMEW

races.name: Close Brothers Rated Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
IF YOU BELIEVE confirmed previous promise when winning at Galway on return and, with the step up in trip likely to suit, he's fancied to follow up. Marco Du Seuil finally got off the mark at Cork 27 days ago and rates the main danger, while Joe Cool is another open to improvement on the back of 2 promising hurdle runs.

  1. IF YOU BELIEVE (IRE)
  2. MARCO DU SEUIL (FR)
  3. JOE COOL (IRE)

races.name: Kettles Country House Hotel Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
GREEN HINT looked a different proposition on his return when cruising clear for success in a Listowel bumper and appeals as one to keep on the right side as he starts off over hurdles. He gets the vote ahead of Premier Division who also showed useful form in bumpers, with Cristal Clere completing the shortlist.

  1. GREEN HINT (IRE)
  2. PREMIER DIVISION (IRE)
  3. CRISTAL CLERE (IRE)

races.name: Francis McGee Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
HEY NOW shaped well on his return when fourth at Wexford and with this longer trip a likely big plus, he edges the vote in this highly competitive handicap. Magic Day could emerge as the main danger on the back of a promising Navan sixth, although a clutch of others also need considering, including Fairlander, Dont Go Yet and Euro Agent.

  1. HEY NOW
  2. MAGIC DAY (IRE)
  3. FAIRLANDER (IRE)

races.name: Willie Elliott Memorial (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
Gordon Elliott saddles a couple of expensive point recruits in UNCLE PAD and Golden Current with the former looking the pick on jockey bookings. Stanger is another likely newcomer from a top stable.

  1. UNCLE PAD (IRE)
  2. GOLDEN CURRENT
  3. STANGER

Prix Du Pont De Tancarville Handicap
